subject.title: feat: add flexible multi-sidebar chat layout

question: Should Control UI adopt this session-scoped multi-column sidebar as the supported default interaction model, including its replacement of the prior single-sidebar sizing preference?
rationale: The branch introduces a broad persisted UI behavior rather than repairing a defined regression, so maintainers need to confirm the intended long-term layout and upgrade semantics after the mechanical session-isolation defect is repaired.

options.title: Sponsor the multi-column model
options.body: Accept the new Control UI direction after the session-isolation repair and real interaction proof demonstrate the intended upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep only a smaller supported sidebar improvement and defer drag-and-drop multi-column persistence until the layout direction is explicitly designed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the multi-column model
recommendation.body: Accept the new Control UI direction after the session-isolation repair and real interaction proof demonstrate the intended upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of the proposed layout model and its recent session-state follow-up commits.
